# FDG6012

> CONSIDER limiting extensibility to only what is absolutely necessary through the use of the Template Method Pattern, described in section 9.9.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 6.1.4 Virtual Members.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: the pattern limits the extensibility that a class offers to subclasses outside the library. Not an analyzer candidate: a design option; section 9.9 describes the pattern, and FDG6013 reports the public virtual members that it replaces with protected virtual ones.
